spans.text: The section below is pulled verbatim from the project’s real spec at build time — graphonomous/docs/spec/README.md. Rename or move it and this build fails.

that makes small language models (1B–8B parameters) smarter over time in their deployment context. It does this by maintaining a self-evolving knowledge graph alongside the model — learning, consolidating, and pruning at inference time — without retraining model weights, requiring cloud connectivity, or suffering catastrophic forgetting.

. The industry's answer — scaling context windows to millions of tokens — is buying around the problem with compute. An 8B model on a $500 edge device should be able to learn from its specific environment. Graphonomous makes that possible.
— The base model is immutable. All learning happens in the graph. 2.
— Designed for constrained devices from day one. SQLite, not Postgres, is the default. 3.
— Structured relationships beat flat similarity search. 4.
— Idle-time memory consolidation inspired by the brain's sleep cycles. 6.
— Every capability is exposed as an MCP tool. No REST API needed unless you want one. 7.
